parsed_json.up: Select the first 200 rows from the metabolism table. Join substrate_record_id to compound_records to retrieve substrate_compound_key, then join to compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. The substrate-side joins are mandatory. Join metabolite_record_id to compound_records to retrieve metabolite_compound_key; this metabolite-side join may be optional. Return canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, and pathway_key. Do not add sorting.
